Four original parts continue along the southward river and adjacent low agricultural floor. Generalized straight segments cross parts of the floodplain and meander interiors while remaining in one connected receiving valley.

The selected eastward loop and following southward continuation correspond to the broad lower-river bend. Mangrove-fringed banks and small neighboring tributaries are distinguishable; no unsupported branch transfer is needed.

The river widens into a mangrove-fringed estuarine corridor and curves east then southwest. Both original parts follow the same open-water/wetland setting; adjacent tidal channels do not receive the representative name automatically.
